model_compound_boundary_transfer.interpretation: The N1-methyl cap is the declared local model for the glycosidic boundary. Numeric bonded terms may seed a smoke candidate after replacing model CM by DNA C1'. The three C6-N1-C1'-sugar dihedrals created by changing the C6 type are mapped deterministically to the three symmetry-equivalent C6-N1-CM-HCM model occurrences. This is not evidence that the transfer is quantitatively accurate in DNA.

provenance_note: Thresholds are conservative NADOC smoke-candidate engineering limits informed by CHARMM/CGenFF target practice. They are not universal force-field acceptance criteria and do not replace the stricter release validation set.
